title: Gekijouban Yatterman: Shin Yattermecha Daishuugou! Omocha no Kuni de Daiketsudan Da Koron!
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 250266. The film is TMDB movie 364134 (Yatterman: All New YatterMechas Assembled! Great Decisive Battle in the Toy Kingdom! (2009)). TMDB show 89323 does not carry it, so the node leaves that show. AniDB episode 1 "Complete Movie" is TVDB S0E3 "Yatterman the Movie". TVDB S0E3 "Yatterman the Movie" is the only feature-length item in the show's season 0 and has the film's release date.
